content: {"like": ["CGI was good and the overall visual style was amazing.", "The cityscape was claustrophobic and futuristic, providing a perfect space for action.", "The film included enough elements from the GITS films to satisfy hardcore fans.", "The performances of Juliette Binoche, Pilou Asbaek, and Takeshi Kitano were praised.", "The clever use of the Major's origin story to explain her new look.", "The inclusion of vintage Lotus cars (Esprit and Excel) as a lovely and unexpected touch."], "dislike": ["Major Kusanagi should have been played by a Japanese actress; the Motoko wig on Scarlett Johansson did not work.", "Scarlett Johansson's performance was described as dire and the dialogue was not great.", "The film's cross-cultural references and having Aramaki speak Japanese were criticized as cultural miscegenation."]}
